production.caller: Scene::apply_one, after the identity check it runs for Insert

specification: For any tree and any patch of the seven variants: an absent identity reports NodeNotFound and the tree is the old tree (Remove: structurally the same). A hit on a field update rewrites exactly the named field of the first preorder match and nothing else. UpdateText and SetCanvas write only a node of the matching kind and otherwise report NotText or NotCanvas with the node unchanged. Insert places the node under the first match at the index clamped to the child count, other fields of that node unchanged. Remove refuses the root with CannotRemoveRoot and otherwise removes the first match as UI-SCENE-NODE-REMOVE-001 states.

Verus+Z3.model_note: Canvas, Style, Semantics and Point are replaced in the proof by value types the kernel cannot read; derives are removed from the proof copies. NodeKind is now the real enum in the proof, so the removal and lookup kernels were rerun on it. The final state of the tree is stated through Verus prophecy on the reference.

Proptest.includes: Arbitrary trees up to 24 nodes with kinds varying by identity and all seven patches, identity domain including the root, against an independent oracle built on an explicit-stack path and functional rebuild

Kani.note: Insert, UpdateSemantics, SetScroll and UpdateText have no Kani result; they rest on Verus and tests. Even the Insert miss did not finish, so the cost is not only the Vec::insert write; the cause is not established. These runs shared the build machine at load about 7 to 14. The stand-in named Canvas is the extracted raster storage, used as an unread payload compared by width.

Loom.reason: The kernel holds no shared state and no synchronization primitive; the tree is taken by &mut, so the compiler excludes concurrent access.
Loom.substitute_evidence: None added: the compiler's exclusive-borrow rule is the argument. It is not a concurrency proof.

real_path_test.mutation_checked: Six manual mutations, one run each, not in the Verus control table: past-the-end index clamped to 0, text admitting other kinds, canvas reporting the wrong refusal, root check skipped, scroll miss reporting Ok, insert miss reporting Ok each failed the new unit test. Four were caught only by the new test among the scene unit tests.

behavior_change_note: apply_one keeps the identity check for Insert and hands the rest to apply_tree_patch. ok_or with ? became match, index.min became if, and the root comparison became id.0. The order of checks and writes is unchanged; that equivalence with the old text is argued by reading and tests, not proved.
